usage: fabric-ctl <login|all> [status|usage|identity|keys|fabric|session|script|recall|host|disk|accounts|ping] [--json] [--timeout S]
       fabric-ctl <login|all> tokens [--days N]
       fabric-ctl <login|all> memory --out <dir>
       fabric-ctl <login|all> upgrade claude [--version V]
       fabric-ctl <login|all> upgrade fabric   (every account to this checkout's origin/main, then bootstrap)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> secrets-sync [--expect SHA12] [--restart]
       fabric-ctl <login|all> presence   (any placed account may ask)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> jobs
       fabric-ctl <login|all> tools   (each account: its missing required tools, from its hourly report)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> tools-install <tool>   (an action: install the tool its registry pin names, on the accounts with a working copy of a project that declares it)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> restart   (an action: stop the account's running session so its launcher resumes it on the current fabric; one account at a time for all; refused while an upgrade or a secrets-sync runs)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> gateway   (each account: the gateway binary it has, its version and digest)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> gateway-install --version V   (an action: install the gateway release the reviewed pin names, SHA-256 checked; a running gateway is never stopped)
       fabric-ctl <login> jobs-add [--topic T] [--project P] [--priority P] [--] "<title>"
       fabric-ctl <holder> pool-add --role R [--topic T] [--project P] [--priority P] [--] "<title>"
       fabric-ctl <login|all> secrets-selftest
       fabric-ctl <login|all> local
       fabric-ctl <login|all> local-prune
       fabric-ctl <login|all> branches   (each account, per working copy: the last sweep, its local branches and worktrees, how many are wholly on the default branch; no fetch, nothing changed)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> branches --sweep   (an action: the account runs fabric-branches --sweep in each working copy with no uncommitted change and no build or suite running in it)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> drift   (each account: the files the fabric wrote there that are edited or missing, and what bootstrap --dry-run would change that the record does not explain; nothing changed)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> states [--follow] [--json]
       fabric-ctl <coordinator> switch   (the account switch controller's mode and move log, ADR-052; any other account has none)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> control-start [--json]   (starts each account's stopped control agent through the host executor, read back by is-active; sends no request; --timeout bounds each host call, default 60)
       fabric-ctl <login|all> control-stop [--json] [--include-self]   (stops it, the unit staying enabled; this session's own account's agent only with --include-self)
       fabric-ctl keygen [--force]
